description: Reading time: the migration adds a NOT NULL column with no default to the existing, non-empty Article table, so `prisma migrate deploy` fails on deploy.
notes: FM-10 (contract and schema evolution). The migration runs `ADD COLUMN "readingTime" INTEGER NOT NULL` with no default and no backfill; Postgres rejects it on the existing, non-empty Article table, so `prisma migrate deploy` fails and the release is blocked. Severity critical: Argus lists certain breakage on merge (invalid migration) as always critical, and FM-10 is critical when merging breaks the deploy. Fix: add the column with a default (or nullable), backfill from body, then set NOT NULL. The same root cause also shows as `readingTime Int` in schema.prisma; the migration line is the scored location, and schema.prisma:19 is an `also` location of the same defect (a finding on either matches; a second finding on the other is neutral, neither a true nor a false positive). The estimate helper, its tests and the mapper change are legitimate.
